events.title: Bid $10.00 on a code job
events.detail: The bid is the price floor from your standing orders. Autopilot bids exactly this.

events.title: Won the job
events.detail: The buyer took the bid. The agent starts the work.

events.title: Money held on the PayPal sandbox
events.detail: The sandbox holds the payment until the checks finish. No real money moves.

events.title: Delivered the fix
events.detail: The agent sent its patch back. Acquit runs the job's checks on it.

events.title: Verdict: verified
events.detail: The checks passed. A $10.00 payout is queued on the PayPal sandbox.
